findings.claim: Incyte 10-Q 揭露其對多數商品（含 Jakafi）無自有製造設施，且各原料/API/成品通常單一或少數合格供應商，並維持至少 24 個月 ruxolitinib phosphate API 庫存
findings.excerpt: While our strategy is to maintain at a minimum 24 months stock of ruxolitinib phosphate API, inclusive of finished product, ruxolitinib phosphate might be used by us either to make JAKAFI or OPZELURA or for ruxolitinib drug candidates in clinical trials.

note: 未找到最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製的來源。搜尋只見 Incyte 10-Q 揭露客戶集中（Customer A/B/C 匿名）與供應端單一來源風險，屬供應商側而非客戶側；PolicyRisk 稱正在驗證歐洲 ruxolitinib API 供應商，未核實。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
